description: This file contains the RouteCollector class for the FastRoute library, which manages the collection and grouping of route definitions, including methods for adding routes for various HTTP methods and creating route groups with common prefixes.

classes.name: RouteCollector
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting and organizing routes, supporting route grouping and method-specific route addition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RouteCollector with a route parser and data generator.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a route for specified HTTP methods, applying current group prefix.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a route group with a common prefix, executing a callback with the group applied.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Adds a GET route to the collection.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Adds a POST route to the collection.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a PUT route to the collection.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Adds a DELETE route to the collection.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Adds a PATCH route to the collection.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Adds a HEAD route to the collection.
